title: Verify the bounded experiment pilot in production before considering promotion

source.ref: Production acceptance referenced by LIVE-2278; existing closed upcoming-next-step catalog and Growth experiment controls.

detail: This is manual production acceptance of the already-built bounded experiment system, not another implementation or a claim that a pilot is active. LIVE-2278 schema and function verification exists; the Growth interface that mounts ExperimentPanel is part of LIVE-2280 and must be available before verifying its operator controls. Use the existing authorized Insights read/write paths and closed upcoming-next-step catalog. Record the actual production state and confirm control/treatment copy, stable eligible-member assignment, foreground-visible exposure and authoritative event.rsvp outcome handling without treating assignment or rendering alone as exposure. Verify browser and account analytics consent plus real staff exclusion, and verify that a consent withdrawal removes membership while preserving only the intended anonymous attrition totals. Observe the real exposure/outcome path without sending synthetic Google conversions or changing unrelated tracking. The reviewed catalog specifies 100 mature exposures per arm, seven days of enrollment and seven days of conversion follow-up; preserve those finite windows and distinguish pending observations, removed memberships and insufficient samples. The implemented evaluator waits for closed enrollment and full follow-up, reports insufficient samples or attrition as inconclusive, and never promotes a variant automatically. Before any promotion, record the existing guardrail review for accessibility, page performance, RSVP failures, cancellations, consent withdrawals and follow-up coverage, then record the observed mature result or explicit inconclusive/keep-control outcome. No production pilot, flag, SQL, permission, Google setting or email is activated by adding this row. Source tests, schema presence and a serving build do not establish live pilot acceptance.

verify.evidence: Checked the existing catalog, runtime, exposure component, operator actions and pending Growth UI mounting on 2026-11-15 UTC. The catalog and schema are built; this lane has not verified an active production pilot, natural foreground exposure/authoritative outcome, live consent withdrawal or completed mature follow-up. Close only with actual authorized production observations and a recorded guardrail/result assessment, retaining an inconclusive or kept-control result honestly. No activation or synthetic provider event was performed for this check.
